thread:
maria: heads-up: mkdocs linkcheck threw a cluster of broken anchors under /guides/migrations after the mdx->mkdocs conversion. lots of headings got line-wrapped and slug generation is inconsistent across OSes.

josh: can you paste a repro?

maria: on the migration guide there was an H3 `### Deployment & routing` that ended up wrapped by the formatter to:
```
### Deployment
& routing
```
Old builds produced `#deployment--routing` but mkdocs now sometimes yields `#deployment` or `#deployment-routing`. links to the old id are flagged.

docs-bot: linkcheck: 12 broken anchors found in docs/guides/migrations/*.md

samir: sounds like the migration script wraps before we normalize. we should collapse whitespace and normalize punctuation on headings prior to wrapping.

laura: Agreed. Also we could make linkcheck tolerant: try multiple slug variants before failing (space->-, &->and, remove duplicate dashes). That gives us breathing room while we fix sources.

maria: opened a small PR that does two things: normalizes headings in the migration step and updates linkcheck to test three variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4129

josh: paste the normalization function?

maria: sure:
```python
import re

def normalize_heading(text):
    # collapse whitespace, convert & to 'and', strip punctuation
    t = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    t = t.replace("&", "and")
    t = re.sub(r"[^\w\- ]", "", t)
    return t
```

samir: can we add a unit test to lock that behavior?

maria: added a small test asserting slug(normalize_heading("Deployment & routing")) == "deployment-and-routing" in the PR.

laura: ran linkcheck locally against the branch. failures drop 12 -> 2. the remaining two are from old example notebooks that include soft linebreaks. i'll fix one and leave a TODO in the other.

josh: also added a tiny resolver in our linkcheck plugin to attempt variants: original, spaces->-, &->and. reduces noise on CI.

docs-bot: ci/linkcheck started for PR #4129

maria: CI green, merging shortly. I'll add a short note to the migration guide about normalized header punctuation so external contributors aren't surprised.

josh: merged. docs deploy scheduled.
